description: Add comprehensive documentation explaining how to configure FastAPI applications using pyproject.toml with entrypoint configuration. This documentation should cover the setup process, configuration options, and practical examples for developers who want to use modern Python packaging standards with FastAPI.
functional_requirements: Create documentation explaining how to configure FastAPI applications using pyproject.toml entrypoints
Include practical examples showing both basic and advanced configuration scenarios
Update the main README and relevant tutorial sections to reference the new pyproject.toml approach
Ensure documentation covers how this approach integrates with existing FastAPI CLI tools
Explain the benefits and use cases for using pyproject.toml entrypoints versus traditional approaches
Include cross-references between the new documentation and existing application structure tutorials
